Questions, answered

Still unsure? Call Nora yourself at (415) 555-0142 and ask her.

Will callers know they’re talking to AI?

Nora introduces herself as your business’s assistant. If a caller asks for a person, she transfers the call or takes a message.

What if Nora can’t answer a question?

She takes a message and texts you right away.

Can I keep my current number?

Yes, via call forwarding.

Which calendars does Nora work with?

Google Calendar, Outlook, Square Appointments, Acuity and Vagaro.

Where is my data stored?

In US data centers, encrypted. We never use call recordings to train models for other businesses. A HIPAA-ready plan for clinics is coming in Q2 2027.

Can I cancel anytime?

Yes. There’s no contract.
